label: Autodig painting
description: Turn autodig marking mode on or off. Mark terrain for selected workers whose autodig is enabled. This changes map input, not zoom.

label: Add dig marks (+)
description: While removing autodig marks, switch to adding marks. Tab toggles between add and remove. This is not a zoom button.

label: Remove dig marks (−)
description: While adding autodig marks, switch to removing marks. Tab toggles between add and remove. This is not a zoom button.

label: Day/night indicator
description: Shows whether it is day or night. This is an indicator, not a command.

label: Worker autodig on/off
description: Toggle autodig separately for each selected worker. Turning it off clears that worker’s dig target, destination and assigned dig marks.

label: Toggle camera marker
description: Show or hide the marker at the centre of the camera view.

label: Find selected unit
description: Centre the camera on the selected units (the middle of the selection).

label: Open information/HUD
description: Open the Remastered information panel. The original border tooltip calls this Updates.

label: Stop selected units
description: Stop selected units: cancel their current and queued tasks, delivery and targets, and keep automated roles and autodig stopped. Other units keep working.

label: Choose race / restart
description: Choose a race and start again. If you already have units, confirmation is required before releasing or removing your existing forces.

label: Private message
description: Choose another online player and send a private message. Shows a notice if nobody else is online.

label: World chat
description: Send a message to world chat, subject to the game’s chat rules and cooldown.

label: Camera waypoints
description: Set or visit one of three camera waypoints. These are camera bookmarks, not queued worker tasks.

label: Select all owned units
description: Add all your non-wagon units throughout the world to the current selection.

label: Select nearby owned units
description: Add your nearby non-wagon units around the camera to the current selection.

label: Build menu
description: Open or close the build menu. Available options depend on selected builders and materials; misted units cannot build.

label: Online players
description: Show which players are currently online.

label: Show coordinates
description: Display the camera’s current X, Y and layer coordinates.

label: Go to coordinates
description: Enter X, Y and layer coordinates to move the camera there. Coordinates are limited to the world boundaries; units do not move.

label: Interact nearby
description: Open the original nearby interaction choices for selected units.

label: Pick up seeds
description: Try picking up seeds within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Collect arrows into quiver
description: Collect nearby arrows into equipped leather quivers. Requires a selected unit wearing a quiver. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up ingots
description: Try picking up ingots within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up gems
description: Try picking up gems within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up stone
description: Try picking up stone within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up wood
description: Try picking up wood within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up bones
description: Try picking up bone items within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Harvest/pick up food and bodies
description: Harvest one available grape or tomato from each nearby plant, then try picking up nearby food and corpses. Uses selected units; they do not travel.

label: Pick up ores
description: Try picking up nearby ores other than stone. Vampires and werewolves skip silver; normal pickup limits apply. Units do not travel.

label: Pick up armour and a weapon
description: Try picking up one nearby item for each selected unit’s chest, legs, arms, head, shield and weapon categories. Normal pickup limits apply; units do not travel.

label: Pick up skins
description: Try picking up skins within one tile of each selected unit, subject to carrying limits and normal pickup restrictions. Units do not travel.

label: Equip equipment
description: Try equipping all equipment carried by selected units, including weapons. Each item must meet the unit’s normal equipment requirements.

label: Unequip equipment
description: Try unequipping all equipment worn or held by selected units, including weapons.

label: Camera up
description: Move the camera up one layer: Hell → Underground → Ground → Sky. Units stay where they are.

label: Camera down
description: Move the camera down one layer: Sky → Ground → Underground → Hell. Units stay where they are.

label: Drop spare equipment here
description: Drop all spare equipment carried by selected units, including spare weapons, on their current tiles. Equipped items stay equipped. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all gems here
description: Drop every carried gem on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all bones here
description: Drop every carried bone item on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all wood here
description: Drop every carried piece of wood on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all food/bodies here
description: Drop all carried food and corpses on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all ores here
description: Drop all carried ores other than stone on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all stone here
description: Drop all carried stone on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Drop all ingots here
description: Drop all carried ingots on each selected unit’s current tile. This does not deliver to a stockpile.

label: Skin carried bodies
description: Try skinning corpses carried by selected units. Requires a suitable creature, carnivore, Butcher Knife or Dagger.

label: Butcher/devour carried bodies
description: Try butchering corpses carried by selected units, subject to creature and tool requirements. Devourers consume eligible bodies and gain egg content instead.
